definitions: To change a situation from bad to good.
To turn so as to face in the opposite direction.
To complete a piece of work or a transaction.
To cause something to face in the opposite direction.
examples: The new manager managed to turn the company around in just six months.
She turned around to see who was calling her name.
We can turn around most orders within 24 hours.
He turned the car around in the narrow street.
pastTenses: turned around (past simple), has/have turned around (present perfect)
